title: Transportable Causal Effect Estimation across Networks under Interference
abstract: arXiv:2608.18932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating causal effects under network interference typically assumes that the network used for training and the network used for deployment coincide. In practice, an intervention is run on one population while the question of interest concerns a different population, and the two generally differ in topology, node-covariate composition, and spillover pathways. Transporting a causal effect across networks is therefore a data-fusion problem that no existing algorithm solves. We employ a selection diagram, extended to the network setting so that covariate shift and structural network shift enter as separate selectors, and derive from it a transport formula for the direct, spillover, and total effects in the deployment population. Each formula makes explicit which interventional mechanism is assumed invariant and which observational distribution must be reweighted. translated_title: 网络干扰下的跨网络可迁移因果效应估计
translated_abstract: 摘要：在网络干扰下估计因果效应通常假设训练网络和部署网络是相同的。然而在实践中，干预在一个群体上实施，而感兴趣的问题涉及另一个群体，这两个群体通常在拓扑结构、节点协变量组成和溢出路径上存在差异。因此，跨网络迁移因果效应是一个数据融合问题，现有算法无法解决。我们采用选择图，并将其扩展到网络设置中，使协变量偏移和结构网络偏移作为独立的选择器进入模型，并从中推导出部署群体中直接效应、溢出效应和总效应的迁移公式。每个公式都明确了哪些干预机制被假设为不变，以及哪些观测分布需要重新加权。然后，我们将这些公式转化为TranCE（迁移因果效应），一种双稳健估计器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种跨网络迁移因果效应估计方法，通过扩展选择图处理拓扑和协变量差异，并推导出直接、溢出和总效应的迁移公式，实现了双稳健估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method for transporting causal effects across networks by extending selection diagrams to handle topological and covariate differences, deriving transport formulas for direct, spillover, and total effects, and implementing a doubly robust estimator.
